conclusions.available: Project work/material and whole curb total are supported. Actual original drawings contain radii and intersection angles; previous final wire lacked sufficient plan geometry.
exact_missing_basis: Complete original-design list of curved BR100.30.18 segments belonging to the exit work, including connection to p90 row labels and resolving p58/p90 numbering.

For each included segment: applicable radius and central angle or exact start/end chainages with a demonstrated curve definition; endpoints at transitions to lowered curb/work boundary must be explicit.
Rule for including/excluding lowered curb, Proletarskaya portions and straight continuations; completeness and rounding of the sum.
conclusions.next_read: Designer CAD/curve-setting-out or curb schedule tied to plan segment IDs is the shortest safe route. A manual bounded review of all original blue arcs is possible, but cannot replace missing ownership/tangent endpoint data with assumed quarter-circles.

conclusions.available: Both stop total operands 108 and 53 are explicitly scoped by station intervals and BR100.30.18 column.
exact_missing_basis: Explicit identification of which curved curb pieces belong to each stop rather than the adjacent exit/road or lawn curb.
Dimensioned curve definition (radius plus central angle/endpoints) or a project curved-length schedule for those pieces.
Complete inclusion boundaries and a sum with stated rounding.
conclusions.next_read: Stop-specific dimensioned curb layout or designer takeoff for both stop intervals; current whole-area table and 30° flare annotations alone do not determine a 13 m circular subtotal.

proof_limits: No new C/N verdict assigned; existing total-length facts retained independently.
No normative/product mark replacement inferred from shape; an installed curved run does not itself establish curved manufactured block type.
No RouterAI, other model, HTTP, database write, production edit or active snapshot modification.
General arc formula L=R*theta is usable only after theta in radians and the actual included segment are established; crossing angle is not blindly substituted.
